changelog.name: 14-0.0.14 Full
changelog.body:
GPS Setter Full 0.0.14 for ARM64, signed with the established release certificate.

## Changes
- Android 14+ system location updates delivered to listeners are now spoofed, including PASSIVE provider updates. Previously, system spoofing replaced last-known locations but could leave delivered updates unchanged.

## Изменения
- В Android 14+ подменяются системные обновления геопозиции, доставляемые слушателям, включая обновления PASSIVE-провайдера. Ранее системная подмена меняла последнюю известную геопозицию, но доставляемые обновления могли оставаться исходными.

Source: https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/releases/tag/v0.0.14

changelog.name: 13-0.0.13 FOSS
changelog.body: FOSS release 0.0.13 for ARM64; includes the voice-recognition second-step reliability fix.

changelog.name: GPS Setter 0.0.9 Full
changelog.body:
GPS Setter 0.0.9 Full release.

- Improved voice selection of saved favorites and added stop commands to disable spoofing.
- Unmatched or cancelled voice input leaves the current spoofing state unchanged.
- Application ID: `io.github.kovag1978_oss.gpssetter`.

**Upgrade notice:** uninstall previous GPS Setter releases using `io.github.kovag1978oss.gpssetter` before installing this release. Android treats the IDs as separate apps, so data and settings are not transferred. The signing certificate is unchanged.

changelog.name: 0.0.8 Full
changelog.body:
Initial LSPosed repository release of GPS Setter Full. Application ID: io.github.kovag1978_oss.gpssetter. Source: https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter

- Set and spoof device location system-wide or per selected apps.
- Save favorite locations and select one by voice from Quick Settings.
- Full flavor uses Google Maps and Google Play services.

changelog.name: GPS Setter 0.0.12 Full
changelog.body:
## Changes
- Localize the voice stop command to the app language (“turn off” in English and “выключить” in Russian) across recognition, prompts, and reserved app commands.
- Clarify the two-step voice prompts and pause before step two.

## Изменения
- Команда остановки соответствует языку приложения («выключить» на русском, “turn off” на английском) в распознавании, подсказках и проверке команд приложений.
- Два шага голосового управления явно подписаны; перед вторым шагом добавлена пауза.

# GPS Setter

[English](README.md) | [Русский](README.ru.md)

[![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter)](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/releases/latest)
[![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/total)](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/releases)
[![License: GPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/github/license/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter)](LICENSE)
[![Open issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter)](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/issues)
[![LSPosed module](https://img.shields.io/badge/LSPosed-Module-blue)](https://modules.lsposed.org/module/io.github.kovag1978_oss.gpssetter/)

GPS Setter is an Xposed location-spoofing module for Android. Set a location system-wide or assign independent coordinates to selected apps. Active spoofed locations are shown on the map, favorites can be selected by voice from Android Quick Settings, and a foreground service keeps the active-spoofing status visible while spoofing is running.

> **Requirements:** Android 8.1 or later and an Xposed-compatible environment such as LSPosed or Vector. LSPosed/Vector usually requires a rooted device. LSPatch can also be used with the module embedded into the target app.

## Download

Download the latest arm64 APK from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/releases/latest):

| Variant | Maps | Fused location provider | Download |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Full** | Google Maps | Google Play services | [Full APK](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/releases/latest/download/app-full-arm64-v8a-release.apk) |
| **FOSS** | MapLibre | microG | [FOSS APK](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/releases/latest/download/app-foss-arm64-v8a-release.apk) |

The current application ID is `io.github.kovag1978_oss.gpssetter`. Releases before v0.0.9 used a different ID (`io.github.kovag1978oss.gpssetter`); Android treats them as separate apps, so uninstall the older app before installing v0.0.9 or later. Its data is not transferred automatically.

## Setup

1. Install the APK and enable **GPS Setter** in LSPosed or Vector.
2. In the manager's scope, enable **Android System** (`android`) for system-wide spoofing. This is optional for app-only spoofing.
3. For the Full variant, enable **Google Play services** (`com.google.android.gms`) if the target uses GMS location APIs. For FOSS, enable the relevant microG package when needed.
4. For app-specific spoofing, also enable each target app in the manager's scope. Choosing an app in GPS Setter does not change LSPosed/Vector scope; scope must be managed there.
5. Select a location and apply it in GPS Setter. Restart target apps after changing Xposed scope; system-wide hooks may require a device reboot.

## Separate app locations

1. Open **Settings → Enable separate control** and select **Apps for separate control**.
2. Assign each app a unique voice command and marker color, then enable its separate profile. Installed Google Play services and Google Services Framework are included in the selectable apps.
3. Choose a location on the map or from favorites. Tap the apply button and choose an app or **All** to update every enabled profile.
4. When profiles are active, tap the separate stop button to choose one active profile or **All**. The system location target is listed when system spoofing is active. Long-press behavior is not used.

Each active app profile has its own ongoing notification. Applying a new location to one app updates that app's notification; stopping it removes only its notification. **All** stops every app profile and system spoofing.

## Voice control

Add the GPS Setter tile to Android Quick Settings and tap it to open Android's speech recognizer. GPS Setter itself does not need to be opened.

- With separate control enabled, the first prompt lists the enabled apps' voice commands and saved favorites and is labeled **Step 1 of 2**.
- Say a favorite name to apply that location to all enabled app profiles in one step, or say **“turn off”** to stop all system and app spoofing.
- Say an app's voice command to select it. After a short pause, the recognizer starts **Step 2 of 2** and names the selected app; say a favorite to set its location or **“turn off”** to stop spoofing for that app.
- With separate control disabled, say a favorite name to set the system location or **“turn off”** to stop system spoofing.
- App voice commands must be unique and cannot be the localized stop command (**“turn off”** in English, **«выключить»** in Russian). Favorite names can be included in longer phrases. Unmatched or cancelled input leaves the current spoofing state unchanged.

The recognition prompt includes the configured app commands and saved favorite names. A long list may be truncated by the speech-recognition app.

## Map and active notifications

- The map displays every active spoofed location: the system location and locations assigned to managed apps. Markers move when coordinates change and disappear when spoofing stops.
- Managed-app marker colors are configured alongside each app's voice command. The system location marker uses its own color; the marker placed by tapping the map is black.
- Nearby active markers are grouped into clusters with visible colored dots. Tap a cluster to spread its markers around the cluster center, with lines connecting them to their original locations; moving the map closes the spider layout and recalculates clusters.
- Active location notifications are ongoing and cannot be dismissed with an ordinary swipe. A foreground service also runs while any system or app-specific spoofing is active. Android or the device manufacturer may still allow the user or system to stop the app or disable its notifications.

## Features

- System-wide or per-app location spoofing through Xposed hooks.
- Independent coordinates, voice commands, and map marker colors for selected apps.
- Live map markers for all active spoofed locations, with colored clusters and an expandable spider layout.
- Randomized coordinates near the selected location.
- Saved favorites with import and export.
- Ongoing active-location notifications and a foreground service while spoofing is in use.
- Full and FOSS variants with different map and fused-location providers.

## How it works

The module hooks Android location APIs, including `Location` and `LocationManager`, and supplies the configured coordinates to hooked apps. System hooking supports location-service changes introduced in Android 14 and later. The Xposed manager controls which processes receive the module; GPS Setter cannot modify that scope itself.

## Credits

- [Android1500/GpsSetter](https://github.com/Android1500/GpsSetter) for the original project.
- [MapLibre](https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-native) and [microG](https://github.com/microg/GmsCore) for the FOSS map and location components.

## Support

If GPS Setter is useful to you, you can [sponsor the project on GitHub](https://github.com/sponsors/kovag1978-oss).

Licensed under [GPL-3.0-only](LICENSE).

# GPS 设置器

[中文](README.md) | [Русский](README.ru.md)

[！[最新版本](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter)](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/releases/latest)
[![下载](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/total)](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/releases)
[![许可证：GPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/github/license/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter)](许可证)
[![未决问题](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter)](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/issues)
[![LSPosed 模块](https://img.shields.io/badge/LSPosed-Module-blue)](https://modules.lsposed.org/module/io.github.kovag1978_oss.gpssetter/)

GPS Setter 是一个适用于 Android 的 Xpose 位置欺骗模块。在系统范围内设置位置或为选定的应用程序分配独立的坐标。活动的欺骗位置显示在地图上，可以通过 Android 快速设置中的语音选择收藏夹，并且前台服务在欺骗运行时保持活动欺骗状态可见。

> **要求：** Android 8.1 或更高版本以及 Xpose 兼容环境，例如 LSPosed 或 Vector。 LSPod/Vector 通常需要 root 设备。 LSPatch 还可以与嵌入到目标应用程序中的模块一起使用。

## 下载

从[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/releases/latest)下载最新的arm64 APK：

|变体 |地图 |融合位置提供商 |下载 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **完整** |谷歌地图 | Google Play 服务 | [完整APK](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/releases/latest/download/app-full-arm64-v8a-release.apk) |
| **自由软件** |自由地图 |微G | [FOSS APK](https://github.com/kovag1978-oss/android_gps_setter/releases/latest/download/app-foss-arm64-v8a-release.apk) |

当前的应用程序ID是“io.github.kovag1978_oss.gpssetter”。 v0.0.9 之前的版本使用不同的 ID (`io.github.kovag1978oss.gpssetter`)； Android 将它们视为单独的应用程序，因此请在安装 v0.0.9 或更高版本之前卸载旧应用程序。其数据不会自动传输。

## 设置

1. 安装 APK 并在 LSPod 或 Vector 中启用 **GPS Setter**。
2. 在管理器范围内，启用 **Android System** (`android`) 进行系统范围的欺骗。对于仅应用程序的欺骗来说，这是可选的。
3. 对于完整版本，如果目标使用 GMS 位置 API，请启用 **Google Play 服务** (`com.google.android.gms`)。对于 FOSS，请在需要时启用相关的 microG 包。
4. 对于特定于应用程序的欺骗，还要在管理器范围内启用每个目标应用程序。在 GPS Setter 中选择应用程序不会更改 LSPod/Vector 范围；范围必须在那里进行管理。
5. 选择一个位置并将其应用到 GPS Setter 中。更改Xpose范围后重新启动目标应用程序；系统范围的挂钩可能需要重新启动设备。

## 单独的应用程序位置

1. 打开**设置 → 启用单独控制**并选择**用于单独控制的应用程序**。
2. 为每个应用程序分配唯一的语音命令和标记颜色，然后启用其单独的配置文件。已安装的 Google Play 服务和 Google Services Framework 包含在可选应用程序中。
3. 在地图上或从收藏夹中选择一个位置。点击应用按钮并选择一个应用程序或**全部**来更新每个启用的配置文件。
4. 当配置文件处于活动状态时，点击单独的停止按钮以选择一个活动配置文件或**全部**。当系统欺骗处于活动状态时，会列出系统位置目标。不使用长按行为。

每个活动的应用程序配置文件都有自己的持续通知。将新位置应用到一个应用程序会更新该应用程序的通知；停止它只会删除它的通知。 **全部** 停止每个应用程序配置文件和系统欺骗。

## 语音控制

将 GPS Setter 磁贴添加到 Android 快速设置并点击它以打开 Android 的语音识别器。 GPS Setter 本身不需要打开。

- 带有独立控制装置启用后，第一个提示列出了启用的应用程序的语音命令和保存的收藏夹，并标记为**第 1 步，共 2 步**。
- 说出一个最喜欢的名称，即可将该位置一步应用到所有已启用的应用程序配置文件，或者说**“关闭”**以停止所有系统和应用程序欺骗。
- 说出应用程序的语音命令来选择它。短暂暂停后，识别器开始 **Step 2 of 2** 并命名所选应用程序；说一个最喜欢的应用程序来设置其位置或**“关闭”**以停止对该应用程序的欺骗。
- 禁用单独控制时，说出最喜欢的名称来设置系统位置或**“关闭”**以停止系统欺骗。
- 应用程序语音命令必须是唯一的，并且不能是本地化的停止命令（**“关闭”** 英语，**«выключить»** 俄语）。最喜欢的名字可以包含在较长的短语中。不匹配或取消的输入会使当前的欺骗状态保持不变。

识别提示包括配置的应用程序命令和保存的收藏夹名称。语音识别应用程序可能会截断长列表。

## 地图和活动通知

- 地图显示每个活动的欺骗位置：系统位置和分配给托管应用程序的位置。当坐标改变时标记会移动，当欺骗停止时标记会消失。
- 托管应用程序标记颜色与每个应用程序的语音命令一起配置。系统位置标记使用自己的颜色；通过点击地图放置的标记是黑色的。
- 附近的活动标记被分组为具有可见彩色点的簇。点击一个簇，将其标记散布在簇中心周围，用线将它们连接到原始位置；移动地图会关闭蜘蛛布局并重新计算集群。
- 活动位置通知正在进行中，无法通过普通滑动来消除。当任何系统或特定于应用程序的欺骗处于活动状态时，前台服务也会运行。 Android 或设备制造商可能仍允许用户或系统停止应用程序或禁用其通知。

## 特点

- 通过 Xpose 挂钩进行系统范围或每个应用程序的位置欺骗。
- 选定应用程序的独立坐标、语音命令和地图标记颜色。
- 所有活跃欺骗地点的实时地图标记，带有彩色簇和可扩展的蜘蛛布局。
- 所选位置附近的随机坐标。
- 通过导入和导出保存收藏夹。
- 使用欺骗时持续的活动位置通知和前台服务。
- 具有不同地图和融合位置提供商的完整版本和自由开源版本。

## 它是如何工作的

该模块挂钩 Android 位置 API，包括“Location”和“LocationManager”，并向挂钩的应用程序提供配置的坐标。系统挂钩支持 Android 14 及更高版本中引入的位置服务更改。 Xpose管理器控制哪些进程接收模块； GPS 设置器无法修改该范围本身。

## 学分

- [Android1500/GpsSetter](https://github.com/Android1500/GpsSetter) 用于原始项目。
- [MapLibre](https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-native) 和 [microG](https://github.com/microg/GmsCore) 用于 FOSS 地图和位置组件。

## 支持

如果 GPS Setter 对您有用，您可以[在 GitHub 上赞助该项目](https://github.com/sponsors/kovag1978-oss)。

根据 [GPL-3.0-only]（许可证）获得许可。
